# PDF to Word service

This backend service acts as the conversion layer for KaatibDocsPro.

## Setup
```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002
```

## Endpoint
- POST /convert

## Response
```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "outputFile": "/tmp/kaatibdocspro/file.docx",
  "message": "Sample conversion result generated by the backend placeholder service."
}
```
